1.title: Charity Autograph Signing
1.summary: Big Money Ballin' K Chase McLaughlin, WR A.J. Brown, TE Travis Kelce, and TE Dallas Goedert are signing autographs at Fleet Farm in exchange for donations to the Salvation Army.

2.title: Holiday Meet-and-Greet
2.summary: Celebrate the season with your favorite players. Enjoy photos, autographs, and exclusive behind-the-scenes stories from the locker room.

3.title: Big Money Field Winter Tour
3.summary: Get an up-close look at where the action unfolds, as well as behind-the-scenes spots you can't see on gameday. Tours begin at the top of each hour and run approximately 45 minutes.

4.title: Community Charity Day
4.summary: Join players, staff, and fellow fans for a day of community service. Activities include youth camps, park cleanup, and a charity raffle.

5.title: Fan Appreciation Scrimmage
5.summary: Watch an open scrimmage, meet the players afterward, and enjoy exclusive merchandise giveaways during this fan-focused celebration.

6.title: Draft Day Watch Party
6.summary: Experience the excitement of Draft Day with live coverage, guest analysts, food trucks, and real-time reactions from the players.

7.title: Training Camp Kickoff
7.summary: Come out for the first day of training camp and catch your favorite players in action. Enjoy fan zones, giveaways, and family-friendly activities.

8.title: Big Money Field Summer Tour
8.summary: Get an up-close look at where the action unfolds, as well as behind-the-scenes spots you can't see on gameday. Tours begin at the top of each hour and run approximately 45 minutes.

9.title: Legends & Owners Dinner
9.summary: A special dinner event for registered Owners featuring retired players, behind-the-scenes stories, and exclusive surprises.
